entries.en: The camera recorded a hawksbill turtle swimming beside the reef.
entries.zh: 相机拍到了一只在珊瑚礁旁游动的玳瑁。

entries.en: The laboratory report identified hay bacillus in the soil sample.
entries.zh: 实验室报告在土壤样本中鉴定出了枯草杆菌。

entries.en: Hay-scented fern covered the slope behind the woodland cabin.
entries.zh: 草香碗蕨覆盖着林中小屋后面的山坡。

entries.en: The farmer harvested head lettuce before the afternoon rain.
entries.zh: 农夫在下午下雨前收获了结球莴苣。

entries.en: The crop survey recorded head smut in two sorghum fields.
entries.zh: 作物调查记录了两块高粱田中出现的丝黑穗病。

entries.en: The marine collection included a preserved heart urchin.
entries.zh: 海洋生物收藏中有一份保存下来的心形海胆标本。

entries.en: Heath aster flowered along the fence at the field's edge.
entries.zh: 石南紫菀沿着田边的围栏开着花。

entries.en: The guide identified several shrubs from the heath family.
entries.zh: 向导辨认出了几种杜鹃花科灌木。

entries.en: The household budget included the winter delivery of heating oil.
entries.zh: 家庭预算包括了冬季送来的民用燃料油费用。

entries.en: The botanist photographed hedge garlic beside the shaded track.
entries.zh: 植物学家在背阴的小路旁拍摄了药用蒜芥。

entries.en: A hedge sparrow hopped beneath the tangled branches.
entries.zh: 一只篱雀在交错的树枝下蹦跳。

entries.meaningZh: 赤血素〔藻类色素的旧称〕
entries.en: The old botanical paper described hematochrome in the algae sample.
entries.zh: 那篇旧植物学论文描述了藻类样本中的赤血素。

entries.en: The student sketched a hemipterous insect beside the specimen label.
entries.zh: 学生在标本标签旁画了一只半翅目昆虫。

entries.en: The herbarium stored hemlock water dropwort in a labelled specimen folder.
entries.zh: 植物标本馆将藏红花色水芹存放在带标签的标本夹里。

entries.en: The archived microbiology report included an analysis of hemolysin.
entries.zh: 存档微生物学报告中包括了一项溶血素分析。

entries.en: Hemp agrimony grew beside the narrow drainage ditch.
entries.zh: 大麻叶泽兰生长在狭窄的排水沟旁。

entries.meaningZh: 水杨梅〔此处指 Geum urbanum〕
entries.en: The field guide showed herb bennet beside a detailed drawing of its leaves.
entries.zh: 野外指南展示了水杨梅，并在旁边附上详细的叶片图。

entries.en: The old garden plan included herb of grace near the kitchen door.
entries.zh: 旧花园设计图中，在厨房门附近安排了芸香。

entries.en: She chose a herbaceous plant for the shaded flower bed.
entries.zh: 她为背阴的花畦选了一种草本植物。

entries.en: A hermit thrush sang beyond the clearing at dusk.
entries.zh: 黄昏时，一只隐居鸫在空地的另一边鸣唱。

entries.en: The research archive contained a diagram of a herpes virus.
entries.zh: 研究档案中有一幅疱疹病毒示意图。

entries.meaningZh: 带状疱疹病毒〔历史称法〕
entries.en: The older medical index used the name herpes zoster virus.
entries.zh: 那份较早的医学索引使用了带状疱疹病毒这一名称。

entries.en: A herring gull stood on the harbour wall above the fishing boats.
entries.zh: 一只银鸥站在渔船上方的港口围墙上。

entries.en: The chemistry exercise asked students to identify a heterocyclic compound.
entries.zh: 化学练习要求学生辨认一种杂环化合物。

entries.en: The medical bibliography listed an early study of a heterophil antibody.
entries.zh: 医学参考书目列出了一项关于嗜异抗体的早期研究。

entries.en: The analyst detected hexacosanoic acid in the wax sample.
entries.zh: 分析员在蜡样本中检测到了二十六烷酸。

entries.en: The metalworker selected a sheet of high brass from the rack.
entries.zh: 金属加工工人从架子上选了一张硬黄铜板。

entries.en: High mallow flowered beside the low wall behind the garden.
entries.zh: 锦葵在花园后面的矮墙旁开着花。

entries.en: The study compared high-density lipoprotein measurements across the samples.
entries.zh: 这项研究比较了各个样本的高密度脂蛋白测量值。

entries.en: The workshop catalogue offered drill bits made from high-speed steel.
entries.zh: 工坊目录提供了高速钢制成的钻头。

entries.en: A highbush cranberry grew beside the old wooden fence.
entries.zh: 一棵三裂叶荚蒾生长在旧木围栏旁。

entries.en: The hill myna called from its perch near the window.
entries.zh: 鹩哥在窗边的栖木上鸣叫。

entries.en: The dog lifted one hind leg over the fallen branch.
entries.zh: 狗抬起一条后腿，跨过了落枝。

entries.en: The skeleton's damaged hind limb was carefully restored.
entries.zh: 骨骼标本受损的后肢经过了仔细修复。

entries.en: The surveyor found a cracked hip tile on the old roof.
entries.zh: 勘察员在旧屋顶上发现了一块开裂的屋脊盖砖。

entries.en: A hoary marmot appeared on the rock above the mountain trail.
entries.zh: 一只灰白旱獭出现在山路上方的岩石上。

entries.en: Hoary plantain grew between the stones beside the path.
entries.zh: 中型车前草生长在小径旁的石缝中。

entries.en: The botanist added hoary puccoon to the meadow survey list.
entries.zh: 植物学家把灰白紫草加入了草地调查清单。

entries.en: The wildlife camera recorded a hog badger crossing the track.
entries.zh: 野生动物相机拍到了一只穿过小路的猪獾。

entries.en: The historical farming record mentioned hog millet among the harvested grains.
entries.zh: 那份历史农事记录在收获的谷物中提到了黍。

entries.en: The herbarium received a specimen of hog peanut from the survey team.
entries.zh: 植物标本馆收到了一份调查队送来的同株二型豆标本。

entries.en: A hog-nosed badger disappeared into the undergrowth beside the stream.
entries.zh: 一只猪獾钻进了溪边的灌木丛，不见了。

entries.en: The documentary showed a hog-nosed skunk searching beneath a fallen log.
entries.zh: 纪录片展示了一只在倒木下搜寻的獾臭鼬。

entries.en: A hognosed skunk appeared briefly in the night-vision recording.
entries.zh: 夜视录像中短暂地出现了一只白背臭鼬。

entries.en: A holly fern grew in the shaded corner of the courtyard.
entries.zh: 一株冬青蕨生长在庭院背阴的角落里。

entries.en: The holm oak shaded the entrance to the stone courtyard.
entries.zh: 圣栎为石院的入口遮阴。

entries.en: The priest carried a small vessel of holy water.
entries.zh: 神父拿着一个装有圣水的小容器。

entries.en: The anatomical illustration showed a homocercal fin on the fish.
entries.zh: 解剖插图展示了这条鱼的正尾鳍。

entries.en: The honey badger emerged from behind the rocks at dusk.
entries.zh: 黄昏时，那只蜜獾从岩石后面走了出来。

entries.en: A honey bear climbed onto the wooden platform in its enclosure.
entries.zh: 一只蜜熊爬上了饲养区内的木平台。

entries.en: The birdwatchers saw a honey buzzard above the wooded slope.
entries.zh: 观鸟者在林木覆盖的山坡上空看到了一只蜂鹰。

entries.en: A honey eater visited the flowers beside the verandah.
entries.zh: 一只食蜜鸟飞到了外廊旁的花间。

entries.en: The researcher photographed honey fungus beside the old stump.
entries.zh: 研究人员在旧树桩旁拍摄了蜜环菌。

entries.en: The botany diagram marked a honey gland at the base of the flower.
entries.zh: 植物学示意图在花的基部标出了一处蜜腺。

entries.en: A honey locust stood beside the entrance to the park.
entries.zh: 一棵北美皂荚树矗立在公园入口旁。

entries.en: The field guide included a close photograph of a honey mushroom.
entries.zh: 野外指南中有一张蜜环菌的近照。

entries.en: The beekeeper chose a honey plant for the new garden border.
entries.zh: 养蜂人为新的花园边带选择了一种蜜源植物。

entries.en: A hooded merganser surfaced beside the reeds near the shore.
entries.zh: 一只镜冠秋沙鸭在岸边附近的芦苇旁浮出了水面。

entries.en: The research vessel passed a hooded seal resting on the ice.
entries.zh: 调查船经过了一只停在冰面上休息的冠海豹。

entries.meaningZh: 镜冠秋沙鸭〔传统英语名称〕
entries.en: The old bird guide included a drawing of a hooded sheldrake.
entries.zh: 那本旧鸟类指南中有一幅镜冠秋沙鸭的图画。

entries.en: The gardener measured the hoop pine beside the school gate.
entries.zh: 园丁测量了校门旁的肯宁南洋杉。

entries.en: The old natural-history book included an illustration of a hoop snake.
entries.zh: 那本旧自然史书中有一幅环箍蛇插图。

entries.en: A hop hornbeam shaded the path beside the visitor centre.
entries.zh: 一棵铁木属植物为游客中心旁的小径遮阴。

entries.en: The museum displayed a horned dinosaur skeleton in the entrance hall.
entries.zh: 博物馆在入口大厅展示了一具角龙骨架。

entries.en: A horned lizard rested on the sandy ground beside the trail.
entries.zh: 一只角蜥停在小径旁的沙地上。
